title: Recovery 2.2-2.7 - the jumper column: RX, TX and RST stay on
caption: The XDS110's serial port reaches the CC3220 through the RX and TX jumpers, its reset through RST. Leave every jumper here as shipped.

callouts.label: GND jumper: as shipped
callouts.note: 'GND' printed left of the row; one cap across its two pins. Not touched in the recovery steps (TI's guide SWRU463 not checked: unverified).

callouts.label: 5V jumper: as shipped
callouts.note: '5V' printed left of the row; one cap across its two pins. Not touched in the recovery steps (TI's guide SWRU463 not checked: unverified).

callouts.label: VBAT jumper: as shipped
callouts.note: 'VBAT' printed left of the row; one cap across its two pins. Not touched in the recovery steps (TI's guide SWRU463 not checked: unverified).

callouts.label: BRD jumper: as shipped
callouts.note: 'BRD' printed left of the row; one cap across its two pins. Not touched in the recovery steps (TI's guide SWRU463 not checked: unverified).

callouts.label: RX jumper: stays ON (UART to the CC3220)
callouts.note: 'RX' printed left of the row. The XDS110's serial port reaches the CC3220 through it. This row has a third pin position on the right: the photo shows the bare pin on the left and the caps over the right-hand part; how they bridge cannot be read from it, so leave them exactly as they are (TI's guide SWRU463 not checked: unverified).

callouts.label: TX jumper: stays ON (UART to the CC3220)
callouts.note: 'TX' printed left of the row. The XDS110's serial port reaches the CC3220 through it. This row has a third pin position on the right: the photo shows the bare pin on the left and the caps over the right-hand part; how they bridge cannot be read from it, so leave them exactly as they are (TI's guide SWRU463 not checked: unverified).

callouts.label: RST jumper: stays ON (reset to the CC3220)
callouts.note: 'RST' printed left of the row; one cap across its two pins. The XDS110 resets the CC3220 through it (TI's guide SWRU463 not checked: unverified).

callouts.label: TMS jumper: as shipped
callouts.note: 'TMS' printed left of the row; one cap across its two pins. Not touched in the recovery steps (TI's guide SWRU463 not checked: unverified).

callouts.label: TCK jumper: as shipped
callouts.note: 'TCK' printed left of the row; one cap across its two pins. Not touched in the recovery steps (TI's guide SWRU463 not checked: unverified).

callouts.label: TDI jumper: as shipped
callouts.note: 'TDI' printed left of the row; one cap across its two pins. Not touched in the recovery steps (TI's guide SWRU463 not checked: unverified).

callouts.label: TDO jumper: as shipped
callouts.note: 'TDO' printed left of the row; one cap across its two pins. Not touched in the recovery steps (TI's guide SWRU463 not checked: unverified).

callouts.label: BRD-SENSE jumper: as shipped
callouts.note: 'BRD' printed left of the row and 'SENSE' right of it, 'J18' below; one cap across its two pins (TI's guide SWRU463 not checked: unverified).
